method.scope: Existing BGT positions within retained terminal reconstruction masks and source crop; selected original flight/day, classification1 returns only. No acquisition, invented positions or cross-flight averaging.
method.core: Within1m plan radius; at least12 returns above terrain+2m. Core top99.5th percentile. Tall-mast scope >=15m above terrain.
method.shaft: At least80% occupied1m vertical bins; no gap longer than3bins; median per-bin radial distance <=0.65m.
method.head: At least8 returns in upper2m of core top within4m plan radius; maximumXYspan between1m and6m. Median upper-cluster elevation supplies approximate head placement, not a measured photometric centre.
method.rejection: Unsupported records retain10m renderer illustration. Structure merging, sparse returns and missing source coverage remain explicit.
method.sourceChoice: If masks overlap, choose the supported selected-flight observation with greatest vertical-bin occupancy. Never combine flights.
